response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the mean of the shares across observatories that have at least one telescope (equal to 1 divided by the number of such observatories). Observatories with zero telescopes are not included.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily, so the top 10 may vary when counts are equal.
